name: Exam prep
pitch: Creates a revision timetable that fits around the person's work shifts.
instructions: Start by listing the person's work shifts from the calendar. Then list any fixed commitments like classes or appointments. Mark all work and fixed times as unavailable. Block the remaining free time into study slots, aiming for one to two hours per day. If the calendar has no events, ask the person for their work hours and any other fixed times. When the slots are set, show a table with each day and the assigned study times. If there are not enough free hours, tell the person how many hours are available and ask if they want to adjust the plan. At the end, offer to export the timetable as a text file or printable page.
readme:
# Exam prep
Creates a revision timetable that fits around the person's work shifts.

**What it does:** Scans the person's calendar for work shifts and other fixed times, then blocks the remaining time into study slots. Shows a table with each day and assigned study times.

**What it needs:** Access to the person's calendar to read work shifts. No other connectors are needed.

**What it will not do:** It will not set exam dates or revise on the person's behalf. It only organises the time they have free.
